notes.title: Soundtrack DLC now available!
notes.notes:
Because many of you have requested a soundtrack, we've put together something for you guys to enjoy! Now you can imagine it's raining on you no matter where you are in the world =O

Note: The files are in OGG format. It's an open and free format you can easily find players/plugins to handle, but many players don't support it by default.
